scope: Python and JavaScript Directus SDK export creation contract; fake client methods only, no HTTP or provider calls
parity: JavaScript exposes createExport() matching Python create_export() and preserves the existing JavaScript create() payload behavior
The Python-parity method carries export_type, optional format, entity_type, entity_ids, target_table, and filters into the export_log request
Both SDKs add pending status and sdk request attribution
limitations: All transport is mocked; no Directus instance or network request was used
This closes one method/type parity gap only; authenticated route, tenant scope, live service, gRPC, and broader SDK parity remain open
